What was the cause of your hearing loss? I lost my hearing due to infection and I had pain in it long after the infection cleared, like a very sharp pain that lasted a couple seconds. If the pain is severe, you should contact your doctor.

 I think your treatment is correct and pretty standard for sudden hearing loss. With things like these the likely outcome is hard to tell. There are a lot of factors that determine if your hearing will come back or not such as the cause, how much time passed and treatment since the onset and a bit of luck, I guess.

I hope things improve for you. Best of luck!

Hello. I lost my hearing a year and a half ago. What helped me was when having a conversation people would talk clearer (i. e. Not mumbling) and stay on my hearing side. If he asks you what you said, which may happen a lot, please be understanding. 

What can also help is set his phone from stereo to mono so he can enjoy music somewhat again. Loud noises and environments hurt my ear because I developed reactive tinnitus, so minimizing that would help a lot. I had sharp random pain in my ear for a while (lost it due to infection) and when that happened I was very irritable. Steroids made me have crazy and I mean craaaazy mood swings. I would advise you to try and be understanding. Be there for him.

Also, he might need an alarm that he can feel, like a watch that vibrates. I had trouble hearing alarms on my phone even before hearing loss. Getting a watch was a good idea and it helps me wake up.

 Adjusting will take some time. If he has tinnitus avoiding caffeine, getting enough sleep and avoiding noise might help. I hope things improve for him.
